manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold and {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Wormfang Drake must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield immediately.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its last ability triggers, returning Glorious Protector to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
